title: Damask wallpaper with a grown symmetric ornament
purpose: Generate tileable maps of damask wallpaper or fabric: a mirror-symmetric ornament grown from a seed (stem, palmette, curling scrolls, leaves) in a half-drop repeat, as tone-on-tone satin against matte, gold print, raised flock or a flat print. Use for period interiors, hotels, theatres and upholstery.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python damask_wallpaper.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: column_pairs
parameters.meaning: Pairs of motif columns across the tile (the half-drop repeats every two columns).

parameters.name: scrolls
parameters.meaning: Pairs of scrolls leaving the stem.

parameters.name: petals
parameters.meaning: Petals in the palmette fan at the top of the motif.

parameters.name: stroke
parameters.meaning: Width of the stems and scrolls.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: Embossed or flocked height of the motif.

parameters.name: weave
parameters.meaning: Strength of the crossed weave stripes that set satin motif against matte ground.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Ivory satin damask: tone on tone, the motif shining against a matte ground.

presets.name: burgundy_gold
presets.description: Metallic gold motif printed on matte deep burgundy.

presets.name: flocked_velvet
presets.description: Raised black velvet flock on a silver sheen ground.

presets.name: teal_print
presets.description: Flat teal print on cream paper, smaller motifs, no weave.

limits: The ornament is assembled from capsules and ellipses by a seeded grammar, so it is a simplified damask-like motif without the outlines, hatching and interlaced detail of a designed damask. The satin effect is approximated by crossed sine stripes in colour and roughness, not by an anisotropic weave model, and the stripes alias below about three pixels per stripe. Flock and emboss are height from a blurred mask. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Mirror-symmetric ornament grammar: stem, palmette fan, curvature-increasing scrolls
Capsule and ellipse painting with wrap-around
Crossed weave stripes for satin against matte
Gaussian-like blur of the motif mask for embossed relief
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
